newsitem.title: INDIA: Bus plunges into India river, 22 feared dead.
newsitem.headline: Bus plunges into India river, 22 feared dead.

text.p: At least 22 people were feared drowned on Saturday when a bus crashed through a guard rail and plunged into a rain-swollen river in northern India, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The news agency said the accident occurred in Uttar Pradesh state's Lalitpur district.
Divers carrying out rescue operations have not recovered any bodies, PTI said. The number of passengers in the bus was not immediately available.
The news agency gave no other details.
